folder.description: The folder that will own the exclusion filter. Format: folders/FOLDER_ID
folder.rationale: This identifies which folder owns the exclusion filter. It has no direct security impact on the exclusion's behavior.

name.description: The name of the logging exclusion. Must be unique within the folder.
name.rationale: Name is a unique identifier for the exclusion filter. It has no security implications beyond being a reference name.

description.description: A user-provided description of the exclusion filter. Maximum length of 800 characters.
description.rationale: Description is metadata only and does not affect any security controls.
description.compliant: Exclude health check logs from development namespace

disabled.description: Whether the exclusion is disabled. If set to true, the exclusion will not be applied to logs. Default: false.
disabled.rationale: If disabled is set to false (default), the exclusion actively filters out logs. Security-critical logs should never be excluded as it creates blind spots for security monitoring and incident response.

filter.description: An advanced logs filter that matches the log entries to be excluded. See [Advanced Log Filters](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/view/advanced-filters) for information on how to write a filter.
filter.rationale: The filter determines which logs are excluded. Excluding security-relevant logs (audit logs, high severity logs, IAM changes) creates critical security blind spots and violates CIS GCP Benchmark requirements. Filters should be restricted to non-security logs only.
